shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat, island-aware logistics, vanilla-exact formation goto, cross-level everything, CE support, elevators, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB (sky-view only).
- Selection survives column view switches. Pocket maps: celestial/climate via GROUND map; fog-mesh self-heal on first view. Underground biome trial notes in pass 16.
- All levels are real maps. Viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.

## REMOVED FEATURES (user directives, revisit-ready postmortems)
**SKYLIGHTS (round 7)** — full postmortem in pass 16: biome lighting mode, stale fog bakes (self-heal KEPT and still active), pocket-map sun rule (KEPT as locked decision), the unverified shaft chain.
**MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (round 12)** — removed entirely per user ("we'll revisit some other time") after live testing showed multi-directional lips and mis-filled tunnels on real terrain. Deleted: GenStep_ABSkyRivers, AutoSkyGen, Waterfalls things/defs/sound/textures, mountainRivers setting, river dev tools, generator entry, Keyed strings; asset manifest emptied; zero stragglers, build green.
**Revisit dossier (what round 8-12 iteration established, so none of it is rediscovered):**
- 1.6 water facts: riverFlowMap is per-variant optional, riverGraph is never scribed (flow must be optional); wide rivers are IsWater composites (IsRiver core + still fringe); width>20 strips the roof (canyons, not tunnels).
- Detection needs THREE signals: thick-roof tunnel, clean canyon flanks (axis scan), and mountain-closeness density (ragged massifs) — all three implemented and functional at removal time.
- Hydrology that user wants: per-FACE — upstream face keeps a tunnel apron (river dives in), downstream lifts with falls at the exit; mountain-source stretches lift whole; the seal must fill the ENTIRE water body (fringe included) + rebuild rock + thick roof.
- Working machinery at removal: ExecuteLift (carve/seal/banks/rim/flow-copy/lips), per-stretch verdicts, multi-source BFS apron, auto sky gen hook, force-lift dev tool. THE UNSOLVED PART: lip DIRECTION/placement on real terrain (multi-directional falls — the flow-dot heuristic misfires on wide/complex water bodies; needs a per-stretch single-exit-face resolution, e.g. one dominant outflow face per lifted stretch instead of per-cell lip decisions) and seal correctness on braided/cave terrain.
- All transferable engine lessons saved to lore (biomes topic).

## VERIFIED
RMB cross-level (USER) · basement behavior (USER) · Batch A (USER).

## USER BUG WAVE 2026-07-24 (5 reports, triaged + fixed this pass)
**Root cause for reports 3/4/5 and part of 1: `MechChargeAcrossLevels` invoked vanilla `JobGiver_GetEnergy.ShouldAutoRecharge` — an INSTANCE method — with `Invoke(null, …)`** → `TargetException` on the first idle colony mech → ABGuard tripped the ENTIRE Logistics subsystem for the session → all cross-level bill supply (report 3: "won't cook from other-floor meat / won't butcher"), bill-product best-storage ferrying (report 5: "drops on floor"), mech charge routing (report 4, misattributed to WVC), and pet-return/haul flows went silently dead. FIXED: postfix takes `__instance` and invokes on it (virtual dispatch also respects WVC-style overrides). Lore saved (harmony).
Secondary fixes shipped with it:
- **Demand fan-cap fix** (CrossLevelDemand.AddRecipeIngredientNeeds): availability over alternative-ingredient defs now sums UNCAPPED, and registration is filtered to defs actually PRESENT in the column (cap kept as bookkeeping bound). Before: blind 40-def cap made meat/corpse ferrying enumeration-order luck on modded games (corpse filters fan out per race).
- **Forbidden-aware availability** (CountOnMap): forbidden stacks no longer count as available (a forbidden corpse on the bench level was suppressing the shortfall that would ferry the usable one up).
- **Mech RMB cross-level orders** (CrossLevelOrders.PlayerCommandable): single + multi RMB redirect and the stairs travel option now accept `IsColonyMechPlayerControlled` alongside colonists. Command range enforced downstream (vanilla providers re-check during virtual rebuild; formation drag filters per-cell; InMechanitorCommandRange already patched into a column cylinder).
Non-bugs from the wave: **report 2 (Horax cult spam)** — verified NOT ours: pocket maps carry no incident target tags (storyteller never targets them), redirects re-aim only already-fired incidents, columnWealth affects points not frequency; likely Anomaly monolith pacing / their 914-mod list. **Report 5's "incompatible group 1"** — per-map storage-group auto-naming collision (both floors can have a "group 1"; dialog only lists the bench map's). Optional future feature: true cross-level "take to specific storage" for bills. Animal area-driven migration question still OPEN with user (tamed non-master animals intentionally never self-migrate).

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky + basement (starter stairs) · AB: basement diagnostic · AB: light diagnostic · AB: RMB diagnostic.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE
0. **Bug-wave fix verification: mech idle near stairs (no TargetException, no Logistics trip), cross-level meat/corpse bill supply, bill product ferrying to other-level storage, drafted mech RMB across levels.**
1. Below-level lighting from the sky view (lamp pools through the gap at night).
2. Animal flow (pet returns + wild hard-overdue escape), direct-to-blueprint hauling.
3. BAM compat (companion ferny.BetterArchitect), Batch B (meditation/pens/cell-casts/rituals), Batch C (companions: Orion.Hospitality, joeownage.automatic.airships).
4. Perf-mod smoke (non-isolated: PO + TPT live), CE-absent palette run, translation audit, soak, publishing prep.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 parity (VERIFIED, now mech-inclusive) · basement (VERIFIED) · direct-to-blueprint hauling · below-level lighting (sky view, belowLighting setting) · animal flow fix (scribed pet returns) · mech charge routing (FIXED instance-invoke) · demand fan-cap + forbidden-availability fixes · BAM compat · perf pass + perf-mod audit · Batch A verified · Batch B/C built pending · logistics/areas/combat as documented. REMOVED: skylights, mountain rivers.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE. Biomes! Caverns. Alpha Biomes. BM + MO. Odyssey + VLE. Misc. Robots + Robots++. Hauler's Dream + PUAH. Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. CE. Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF. Medieval Trader Airships (+legacy), Hospitality (Continued). Better Architect Menu. Performance Optimizer + Dubs Performance Analyzer + Turret Performance Tweaks (decompile-audited). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. WVC work modes: charge-postfix now dispatches virtually through their overrides.

## Status
2026-07-24 (23rd pass): **user bug wave triaged — one root cause (Invoke(null) on instance ShouldAutoRecharge) killed Logistics and explained 3 of 5 reports; fixed + demand fan-cap/forbidden fixes + mech RMB orders, build green.** Awaiting in-game verification (queue item 0). Horax spam ruled not-ours; animal migration feature question open.
